High proficiency in API testing tools such as Postman, Newman, SoapUI, ReadyAPI, or JMeter. Strong grasp of API authentication protocols, message brokers, HTTP status code semantics, and distributed system architectures. ISTQB Certified Tester (Advanced Level - Technical Test Analyst or Agile Tester), Postman API Fundamentals / Certified Automation, and IBM Certified Associate (webMethods) certifications are preferred.
